strings.en: I will carry out the mission swiftly.
You cannot stop this Gyanonia Ogre.
If you will not comply with our demands...!
I show no mercy to those who oppose me.
This too is for my brethren...!
You're within the Gyanonia's attack range.
I won't let you reach the Rabulpaila...!
You will not pass, Steel Dragons...!
I'll grant you the resolve to come out alone.
Fairy, I act out of concern/　for the future of Gadisword...!
You have no need to know the facts...!
Knowing the truth/　won't change Gadisword's situation...!
I won't let you or Fairy go any further.
Without Zemon and the Rabulpaila,/　Gadisword's future cannot be won...!
I cannot entrust Gadisword's future/　to the Earthlings...!
Sieg, I will destroy your machine...!
Do you want to be executed as a traitor...!
Sieg, I won't let you reach the Rabulpaila.
Sally, I will destroy your machine...!
That resolve of yours/　does Gadisword no good...!
You can't move nimbly with that equipment.
SRX... I will defeat the Steel Dragons' main force.
Our strengths are the same.../　Then the pilot's skill will decide it.
I'm confident in my charging power too...!
One of the largest machines... A worthy opponent!
If I get in close before you can take aim...!
I'll down the Grungust type/　and cut the Steel Dragons' strength.
So this is the mobile weapon/　Golaikunru has its eye on...!
The mobile weapon Golaikunru fears most.../　No ordinary opponent.
Reckless bravado will be your undoing.
I'm nearing my limit... I must end this quickly!
Ngh! If I can just keep my thrust up!
I can't abandon the mission here...!
I won't be swallowed by the situation./　I still have moves left!
Neither Gadisword nor I can end here...!
I must hold back the Steel Dragons at all costs...!
Just a little longer... a little longer,/　and the Rabulpaila will...
If the Hagane weren't behind him, he'd be...!
So you're focusing on me alone!
Fairy, I will stop you here, no matter what!
Fairy, to stand against the aliens,/　we need Zemon and the Rabulpaila...!
You'll defy me to the end, Sally...!
Someone who matches me in high-speed combat...!/　But I won't let you go any further!
So you do stand in my way, SRX!
Its burst speed exceeds the Gyanonia's...?!
A strike without hesitation... As expected, skilled!
Masoukishin, how much power are you hiding...?!
I'll need to update the target's data.
That group... As expected, they're formidable.
Equal in prowess... but not in resolve.
I can't let them gain momentum...!
I cannot retreat from this battle...!
The defense line must be held at all costs...!
I've seen the resolve it took to come out alone.
Don't think willpower alone can down this Gyanonia.
Still hanging on, even at this point...!
Relying on firepower won't defeat me.
Is the Dragous lending it strength...?!
First, I must neutralize/　that weapon module...!
Ngh, the SRX's power is formidable...!
I understood it from the data, but those maneuvers...!
It's accelerating faster than the Gyanonia...!
Ngh... No wonder Golaikunru is wary of it.
So you landed a hit on the Gyanonia Ogre.
In this situation... I never thought I could/　stop the Steel Dragons unscathed.
You don't have the power you had earlier.
Fairy, you'd come at me in this situation...!
What good will siding with the Earthlings do...?
Sally, softness will get you killed.
SRX... Unstable, just as the data says.
Its power is formidable,/　but if it moves in straight lines...!
That big machine moving around is troublesome...!
I just need to parry the great sword...!
You can't catch the Gyanonia Ogre.
Not when I know I'm being targeted.
A reckless charge is easily deflected.
You seem to be hesitating, Sieg.
You may have charging power, but you can't turn tight.
I have no choice but to wait for an opening.
I've lost sight of the target.
So it slipped out of my range.
I'll eliminate you in one go!
I'll show you the Gyanonia Ogre's true form!
